name: Privilege Map LAB
description: The PingOne Privilege Federated Identity model as ReactFlow diagrams you can drag and walk through, plus 41 Privilege feature cards (each with its own diagram and status badge; 33 are internal and confidential), stories and a talk track. Mock only.
notes: Host-run: npm ci && npm run build && npm start (port 5300). Or: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:5301 only). No catalog row matches this app yet, so there is no catalogId.
